Run ONTraC niche trajectories

Source: R/tool-ontrac.R
runONTraC.Rd

Runs ONTraC (Wang et al. 2025) on the cell types and spatial locations of a giotto object and stores its results:

  • cell metadata <name>_NTScore (niche trajectory score of each cell) and <name>_niche_cluster (most likely niche cluster, ordered by the clusters' NT scores);

  • a spatial enrichment <name> with each cell's niche cluster probabilities. Its misc holds niche_clusters (each cluster's NT score) and connectivity (cluster x cluster).

ONTraC is a Python package, installed in a cached environment the first time this runs. If you use it, please cite the original paper (see ontracParam()).

Usage

runONTraC(
  gobject,
  cell_type,
  spat_unit = NULL,
  feat_type = NULL,
  spat_loc_name = "raw",
  sample_column = NULL,
  param = NULL,
  name = "ontrac",
  verbose = NULL
)

Arguments

gobject

giotto object

cell_type

cell metadata column with the cell types

spat_unit, feat_type

spatial unit and feature type

spat_loc_name

name of the spatial locations

sample_column

optional cell metadata column with the sample of each cell; one sample when NULL

param

an ontracParam(); its defaults when NULL

name

prefix of the results

verbose

be verbose

Value

The giotto object with the results.

Details

Plot the results with Giotto's plots:

  • niche clusters in space: spatPlot2D(g, cell_color = "<name>_niche_cluster")

  • niche cluster probabilities in space: spatCellPlot2D(g, spat_enr_names = "<name>", cell_annotation_values = <clusters>)

  • NT score per cell type: ridgePlot(g, feats = "<name>_NTScore", group_by = <cell_type>)

  • cell type composition of the niche clusters: plotLabelComposition(g, groups = "<name>_niche_cluster", labels = <cell_type>)

  • how the niche clusters connect: plotONTraCConnectivity()

References

Wang W, Zheng S, Shin SC, Chávez-Fuentes JC, Yuan GC. ONTraC characterizes spatially continuous variations of tissue microenvironment through niche trajectory analysis. Genome Biology 26, 117 (2025). doi:10.1186/s13059-025-03588-5

See also

ontracParam(), plotONTraCConnectivity()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
g <- GiottoData::loadGiottoMini("vizgen")
g <- runONTraC(g, cell_type = "leiden_clus", spat_unit = "aggregate",
    param = ontracParam(n_neighbors = 30, n_local = 10))
} # }
